rejected_detail.title: PR's own motion measurements are arithmetically impossible
rejected_detail.reason: Mechanically re-run by Perkins with the RLSW-built harness at the reviewed sha: both strips regenerate byte-identical to the minion's, the tool output reproduces the PR body's summary verbatim (21/24→10/24 holds, 30.6→11.2px). The totals reconcile — the AFTER window includes the arrival glide + doorstep phase the quantized BEFORE render aliases. Not a defect.

positive_verifications: View-layer only (ODN-1): zero core/ files in the diff; LOG_VERSION untouched; pkt_interp lives in View, read/written only by render code
Identity guards cover every teleport class: spawn (no row → snap), sever drop-back + ECMP reroute (anchor mismatch → snap), delivery (skip + row-tick gap), multi-step catch-up/pause (tick gap → snap)
Zero-golden-impact by construction holds: harness paths all default interp_alpha=1.0; cache never allocated on the snapshot path
Measurement honest: fresh strips byte-identical to the minion's; determinism confirmed
Local suite green at the reviewed sha: 46/46 demos (T1+T2+replay), odin test app/render 13/13
Reduced-motion canon respected in code: echoes gated on !reduced_motion, live packet + glide stay (automated reachability gap filed separately)

findings.title: Sub-tick interpolation core (interp_continuous guard + packet_interp_pos row-roll/snap) has zero automated coverage — manual evidence only
findings.detail: P0: the round's hard bar (identity-guarded snap on spawn/sever/reroute) is enforced by no gate — motion-strip is in no CI run; T1/T2/replay all render at alpha=1.0 and never execute the interp path. hud_test/wire_path_test/palette_polish_test prove app/render @(test) is established convention.
findings.recommended_fix: Add app/render/motion_test.odin: interp_continuous's four continuous kinds + every teleport snap + row-roll alpha endpoints; joins the existing `odin test app/render` CI gate.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
findings.detail: P0 (sub-tick interpolation + identity guard) 0% automated — manual evidence only. P1 snapshot-exact default path 100% (46/46 demos green, verified by Perkins). Size re-bless + motion T1/replay 100%. Overall ~43%. P0 <100% → FAIL.
findings.recommended_fix: Ship motion_test.odin (identity cases, row-roll endpoints, trail order, prune/reset) in the existing `odin test app/render` gate — gate flips to PASS.

findings.title: measure_packet_motion.py: ZeroDivisionError when the after-strip has no moving frames
findings.detail: The mean line guards only on b_steps; an all-holds after-dir (window fully post-arrival) crashes len(a_steps)==0.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard the AFTER mean on a_steps too; print AFTER=n/a when empty.

findings.title: measure_packet_motion.py: zip(before, after) silently truncates on frame-count mismatch
findings.detail: Dirs with different frame counts pair positionally and drop the tail silently; holds/means still use full lengths — misleading evidence with no warning.
findings.recommended_fix: Compare lengths (and frame names) before printing; exit 2 on mismatch.

findings.title: render_strip_frame ignores rl.ExportImage's failure and still counts the frame — verb reports success with an empty/partial outdir
findings.detail: On a failed write every export can fail yet the verb exits 0 printing 'N frame(s)'. Siblings check the bool (goldens.odin:146, map_preview.odin:117, overlay.odin:122, wire_preview.odin:108).
findings.recommended_fix: Bind and check the result: `if !rl.ExportImage(...) { fmt.eprintfln(...); return 2 }`.

findings.title: Reduced-motion echo-off gate is unreachable by every automated gate — a11y_reduced golden cannot exercise it
findings.detail: Golden captures render snapshot-exact (alpha=1.0 → trail_n always 0), so the `!v.reduced_motion` branch never evaluates under any gate. The E9.2/7.3 canon contract (echoes off, glide stays) is verified by nothing automated.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a unit assertion of the draw predicate (trail_n>0 && !reduced_motion) or a gated motion-strip a11y_reduced interp run asserting zero echo pixels.

findings.title: measure_packet_motion.py counts a lost packet track as a 'hold', inflating the headline metric
findings.detail: When no exact-color cluster is found, displacement records 0.0 and counts as a hold — a lost track is indistinguishable from a stationary packet.
findings.recommended_fix: Track found/lost per frame; exclude lost frames from holds or report separately.

findings.title: demos/motion.dem claims the strip window has 'no arrivals', but the PR's own data shows ~10 of 24 AFTER frames are post-arrival
findings.detail: t50=2500ms; the window runs to 2600ms — ~100ms is post-arrival by the demo's own timeline; the PR annotates 10 frames '(post-arrival)'.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the comment (window includes arrival + doorstep) or narrow the window to end before ~2450ms.

findings.title: Trail ring shift path hardcodes capacity 3 (trail[2]) while the append path is length-generic
findings.detail: Echo capacity 3 is restated in three places (trail[2], TRAIL_FADES[3], trail:[3]); resizing without editing trail[2] silently misaligns fades.
findings.recommended_fix: Use trail[len(trail)-1] or a named ECHO_N constant.

findings.title: motion-strip silently ignores a 6th argument that isn't the literal 'snapshot'
findings.detail: A typo'd mode token is accepted and quietly runs interp mode — producing the opposite evidence strip of what was asked.

findings.title: render_strip_frame's `cat` parameter is never used
findings.detail: The body never reads `cat`; dead weight that misleads readers.
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the parameter; update its single call site.

findings.title: measure_packet_motion.py: missing dir or stray non-PNG file crashes with a raw traceback
findings.detail: No existence/format validation: missing dir → FileNotFoundError; a .DS_Store → PIL UnidentifiedImageError.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard os.path.isdir; filter entries to *.png with a clean message.

findings.title: Literal AC 'motion strip captures at 100 ms' is unsatisfiable — evidence substituted with 60 Hz (17 ms) captures
findings.detail: 100 ms cadence is tick-aligned (2×50 ms) and steps identically before/after; the intent is met by the 17 ms strip + displacement table, and the deviation is documented in the field notes.
findings.recommended_fix: Amend the acceptance line to '60 Hz (17 ms cadence) strip captures show continuous progression'.

findings.title: Trail echo ring duplicates the live packet shape geometry in a second switch
findings.detail: The same 0.866/0.5/0.78 geometry restated; a new Packet_Shape case added to the live draw would silently render circle trails.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract a shared draw_packet_shape(center, r, outline, body) proc; call from both blocks.

findings.title: run_motion_strip adds a third hand-copied demo setup/driver orchestration
findings.detail: Third copy of the Demo_Replay setup + wall-tick walk (run_demo, overlay_check, run_motion_strip); a future run-setup directive missed here silently renders strips off the blessed timeline.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract shared demo_begin + step-once helpers; call from all three.

findings.title: motion-strip prime render discards capture_frame's image without UnloadImage
findings.detail: Each prime tick leaks ~3.5MB (1280×720 readback); a strip window primes ~17+ times. Every other capture_frame call site unloads. Short-lived CLI, so note-tier.

findings.title: packet_interp_prune bound and run-start cache reset have no coverage
findings.detail: P3: the monotonic-id row bound and the stale-row reset are app-path hygiene with no test; a prune regression grows the map unboundedly in long sessions.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend the motion unit test: prune keeps only live ids, no-ops under threshold; reset empties the map.
